title: A Big Bridge to Crimea Is Badly Damaged
summary: Ukraine says it has badly damaged a big bridge that links Russia to Crimea. The bridge carries cars and trains. It is an important road for Russian soldiers going to the front line of the war. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attack was an 'unprecedented operation' that took weeks to plan. Video showed a large part of the bridge's road broken, with pieces falling into the water below. Zelensky said Ukrainian soldiers worked in seven steps. First they knocked out air defense systems, radars and other equipment. Then they hit the bridge. The rail part of the bridge was also hit by drones, but its arch is still standing, and some trains are still running. Russia built the bridge after it took Crimea in 2014. President Vladimir Putin opened it in 2018. The Kremlin says the bridge will be rebuilt 'better than before.' Russia also said it has opened a criminal case about the attack. The attack came just before Putin was to meet the leaders of China and the United States.
why_it_matters: Wars far away can still affect the news and the world children grow up in.
